summary:
Full B2G Greek CIUS + myDATA pagination verification on demo org fa82eab8-... via a new tsx harness (/app/frontend/tests/harness/qa3-b2g-verify.ts) that calls the ACTUAL service functions (validateB2G, buildXmlFor, sendB2G) against the live SQLite DB, plus a Playwright UI check against the preview URL. RESULT: 34/34 harness assertions PASSED and UI regression PASSED. Note: the ##INVOICE|URL## assertion only passes when APP_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL env vars are exported to the tsx process (they ARE set in /app/frontend/.env, so Next.js prod flow always produces the URL; only the standalone tsx runner needed the env forwarded). Run command:
  cd /app/frontend && APP_URL=$(grep ^APP_URL .env|cut -d= -f2) NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=$(grep ^APP_URL .env|cut -d= -f2) npx tsx tests/harness/qa3-b2g-verify.ts

VERIFIED (harness):
 • Org fa82eab8 has b2gEnabled=1, provider=simulation, IBAN configured.
 • Customer QA3-ΔΗΜΟΣ ΔΟΚΙΜΗΣ upserted with publicEntity=true, AFM 090165560, BT-46 '1017.000000000.0183', CPV '72000000-5', BT-11 '1|602ΚΚ2Π-ΨΞ4', BT-12 '24SYMV001234567' — persisted to SQLite customers table (all b2g_* columns).
 • Invoice ΤΠΥ 2.1 100+24, issued 2026-10-20, mydataMark set. Empty invoice refs → validateB2G returns NO BT-11/12/46 or ΜΑΡΚ errors (inherited from customer + MARK present).
 • Invoice-level b2gCpv='123' → validateB2G returns CPV error. b2gCpv='48000000-8' → validateB2G returns [].
 • UBL XML BT-1 cbc:ID = '800000118|20/10/2026|0|2.1|ΤΠΥ|<n>' (6 pipe-segments, format ΑΦΜ|dd/MM/yyyy|branch|type|series|number).
 • ##M.AR.K## AdditionalDocumentReference contains the exact MARK.
 • ##INVOICE|URL## AdditionalDocumentReference wraps cac:Attachment/cac:ExternalReference/cbc:URI = https://cashflow-pro-295.preview.emergentagent.com/p/<publicToken>.
 • ContractDocumentReference ID = '24SYMV001234567' (from customer BT-12).
 • ProjectReference ID = '1|602ΚΚ2Π-ΨΞ4' (from customer BT-11).
 • AccountingCustomerParty cbc:EndpointID schemeID='9933' value='997001671' (fixed KE.D.).
 • AccountingCustomerParty PartyIdentification cbc:ID = '1017.000000000.0183' (BT-46).
 • Line CommodityClassification/ItemClassificationCode listID='STI' value='48000000-8' (invoice CPV overrides).
 • CustomizationID = 'urn:cen.eu:en16931:2017#compliant#urn:fdc:peppol.eu:2017:poacc:billing:3.0' and ProfileID = 'urn:fdc:peppol.eu:2017:poacc:billing:01:1.0'.
 • Supplier PartyTaxScheme cbc:CompanyID starts with 'EL' (EL800000118).
 • Element ORDER inside root: ContractDocumentReference (784) < AdditionalDocumentReference (879) < ProjectReference (1039) < AccountingSupplierParty (1114). Correct.
 • b2gSoftReject=true → XML adds <cac:AdditionalDocumentReference><cbc:ID>SR</cbc:ID><cbc:DocumentDescription>##SOFT|REJECT##.
 • sendB2G (simulation) → status=pending, providerId='SIM-...' persisted; b2gStatus='pending'. Post-send, alreadySent gating is true, which the b2g-card passes as locked=true to B2GRefsForm → inputs disabled + save button hidden. Verified in UI (see below).
 • Negative: issued invoice of publicEntity with mydataMark=null → validateB2G contains 'ΜΑΡΚ myDATA (GR-R-004)' message; buildXmlFor throws with 'ΜΑΡΚ' → /api/invoices/<id>/ubl route returns 422 JSON error (verified by code path in /app/frontend/src/app/api/invoices/[id]/ubl/route.ts line 20).
 • Customer with b2gBuyerIdentifier='' → validateB2G contains BT-46 message ('Λείπει ο κωδικός Αναθέτουσας Αρχής (BT-46, «C.A. label code»)').
 • Credit note 5.1 correlated to the ΤΠΥ above (customerId + currency + non-credit precedent): UBL root <CreditNote xmlns="...CreditNote-2">, CreditNoteTypeCode=381, no <cbc:DueDate>, <cac:BillingReference><cac:InvoiceDocumentReference><cbc:ID>800000118|20/10/2026|0|2.1|ΤΠΥ|<n></cbc:ID> (6-segment BT-1 of original), <cac:ProjectReference> present (branches to ProjectReference when precedingInvoice exists per ubl.ts:239).
 • myDATA pagination (grep on /app/frontend/src/lib/mydata/client.ts): requestDocs, requestTransmittedDocs, requestMyIncome ALL call requestAllPages(); requestAllPages handles both nextPartitionKey and nextRowKey via regex + URLSearchParams.
 • Duplicate-transmission guard (invoices.ts:448-456): before calling sendInvoices() on retry, transmitToMyData calls requestTransmittedDocs and, if the (series, aa) is already present remotely (and not cancelled), adopts the remote MARK and marks status='sent' — code inspection confirmed.

VERIFIED (Playwright / preview URL):
 • demo@timologio.gr login → dashboard OK.
 • /invoices renders with data-testid='filter-bar' (HTTP 200).
 • /customers renders (HTTP 200).
 • /settings?tab=appearance renders (HTTP 200).
 • Random QA3 invoice page (/invoices/ad7683db-e02d-445a-8ff3-2e59b771728b, ΤΠΥ-1310, QA3-ΔΗΜΟΣ ΔΟΚΙΜΗΣ) shows Τιμολόγηση Δημοσίου card with 'Σε αναμονή παρόχου' + B2GRefsForm rendered.
 • data-testid='b2g-card' present ✓, data-testid='b2g-refs-form' present ✓, data-testid='b2g-ref-project' input DISABLED ✓ (locked after simulation send), 'b2g-refs-save' button ABSENT ✓ (b2g-refs-form.tsx:57 hides save when locked).
 • GET /api/invoices/<id>/ubl through browser session → HTTP 200, content-type application/xml; charset=utf-8, 4967 bytes, starts '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Invoice xmlns=...'.
 • Console errors: 0 (only 4 unrelated font-preload warnings — Next.js chunks not used within N seconds; benign).
verified_working: CPV per line with listID='STI'; invoice CPV overrides customer
Credit note 5.1: CreditNote root, no cbc:DueDate, TypeCode=381, BillingReference 6-segment, ProjectReference when preceding exists
Element order: ContractDocumentReference → AdditionalDocumentReference → ProjectReference → AccountingSupplierParty
Customer form fields b2g-buyer-identifier + b2g-cpv save to customers.b2g_buyer_identifier / customers.b2g_cpv
b2g-refs-form locks (inputs disabled, save button hidden) after alreadySent
Negative: no-MARK public-entity issued invoice → validation GR-R-004 + /api/invoices/<id>/ubl returns 422 with ΜΑΡΚ message
Negative: missing BT-46 → validation mentions BT-46
myDATA requestAllPages iterates continuationToken (nextPartitionKey/nextRowKey) — used by requestDocs, requestTransmittedDocs, requestMyIncome
myDATA duplicate-transmission idempotency: on retry after prior error, adopts existing MARK from RequestTransmittedDocs (invoices.ts:448-456)
UI regression: /invoices, /customers, /settings?tab=appearance render without console errors
critical_code_review_comments: lib/b2g/ubl.ts: element order is enforced by construction (Contract → Additional → Project → Supplier); good. The ternary at line 239 correctly routes credit notes without a preceding invoice into an AdditionalDocumentReference with DocumentTypeCode 50 + ##PROJECT|REFERENCE##, and with a preceding invoice into a plain ProjectReference — matches the review spec.

lib/services/b2g.ts:validateB2G is complete: covers B2G enabled, invoice kind, status, adjustments (withhold/stamp), correlation, publicEntity flag, org AFM+IBAN, buyer AFM validity, BT-46/12/11, CPV format, MARK for GR issuer, legal name, EUR-only, lines present + descriptions.
lib/mydata/client.ts:requestAllPages caps at 50 pages — reasonable safety net; downstream parseTransmittedDocs/parseRequestedDocs/parseMyIncome are called per-page and results are flatMapped.
lib/services/invoices.ts:448-456 idempotency guard scopes lookup by (seriesCode, aa) AND filters out cancelledByMark — correct behavior on retry after timeout error.
app/actions/b2g.ts:saveB2GInvoiceRefsAction refuses updates when b2gStatus ∈ (pending/sent/accepted) — consistent with b2g-refs-form locking; good UX/data-integrity coupling.
app/api/invoices/[id]/ubl/route.ts returns 422 JSON on build failure — the client (b2g-card download button) surfaces the message via toast; correct.
seed_data_creation: Left QA3 seed data on demo org fa82eab8-...: customer 'QA3-ΔΗΜΟΣ ΔΟΚΙΜΗΣ' (publicEntity, AFM 090165560, BT-46 1017.000000000.0183, CPV 72000000-5, BT-11 '1|602ΚΚ2Π-ΨΞ4', BT-12 24SYMV001234567); one issued ΤΠΥ 2.1 invoice with mydataMark, b2gCpv='48000000-8', b2gSoftReject=1, b2gStatus='pending' (SIM-...); one issued ΤΠΥ 2.1 invoice with mydataMark=null (used for GR-R-004 negative); one issued πιστωτικό 5.1 correlated to the ΤΠΥ with mydataMark set. All idempotent-safe with number offset +500/+100.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rerun with: `cd /app/frontend && APP_URL=$(grep ^APP_URL .env|cut -d= -f2) NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=$(grep ^APP_URL .env|cut -d= -f2) npx tsx tests/harness/qa3-b2g-verify.ts` — script is idempotent (upserts customer, uses number = max+500/+100 per series). Requires the /app/frontend/node_modules/server-only stub that iteration 51 installed. Sample XMLs at /tmp/qa3_ubl_invoice.xml and /tmp/qa3_ubl_creditnote.xml. The MARK adoption guard cannot be exercised offline without a mock 'request()' — inspection-only per review spec.
